[Music]
mommy tells me it's a seashell day
I rushed down the path over the Dune
salty breeze blows we'll be there soon
we reached the beach Herring goals flock
is this a seashell no it's a rock
thank you
with pale and shovel in my hand my toes
squish in cool wet sand
a wave rolls in it's way too big go away
wave so I can dig
bumpy

[Music]
spiny shiny shells
a penny for luck
my shell is Tiny a silvery Pearl
mommy's is brown with a big
Burly curl
this shell is a home mommy tells me
let's put it back to live in the sea
[Music]
this shell has a secret hold it up to
your ear
my sin says mommy what do you hear
[Music]
[Applause]
I hear the ocean
I count shells one two three four
each one is different I have many more
[Music]
I count other shells five six seven
eight
my shells are curvy never straight
two more shells numbers nine then ten
when we get home let's count them again
[Music]
we are almost home it's been a fun day
so many shells oh make a display
one

five six
seven
eight oh my shells look really great

from the sea I brought the beach home

[Music]
mollusks are animals with soft bodies
that wear their skeletons on the outside
seashells
[Music]
every empty seashell on the beach was
once a part of an animal from the
mollusk family
seashells are mostly made of calcium so
are our bones
[Music]

the best time to find seashells on the
beach is in the morning or evening at
low tide
[Music]

them see Predators coming from any
direction
[Music]
seashells can be as small as a grain of
rice or as big as four feet across
[Music]
there are more than one hundred thousand
species of mollusks worldwide
[Music]
about half of all mollusks live in the
ocean
[Music]
a seashore wraps around a mollusk's body
like a suit of armor
[Music]
it protects the sea creature living
inside from predators and strong ocean
currents under sea
foreign
crabs crawl into empty seashells and
call them home
as hermit crabs grow bigger they have to
find larger and larger shells
mini clams breathe through a kind of
snorkel a body part called a siphon when
they bury themselves in sand
[Music]
shells have been used throughout history
for art jewelry money tools containers
and buttons
[Music]
the end

to get books because it's full of

go in the car in a plane even on the

wait around ask your grown-ups to
download books now you'll be glad you
